children: Brunswick Executive Chairman and Chief Executive David Foulkes is stepping down and will hand the separated roles to company insiders.
The Illinois-based marine manufacturing company said Foulkes will retire at the end of the year, having served as chairman since February 2025 and CEO since the start of 2019.

Aine Denari, currently president of Navico and Brunswick's chief technology officer has been appointed CEO and will join Brunswick's board effective Jan. 1, the company said. David Everitt, who is lead independent director, will assume the role of non-executive chairman, also effective the start of next year.

Prior to his appointment as CEO, Foulkes served as the company's first chief technology officer and ran Brunswick's Boat Group and financial services businesses. His first role with Brunswick was as vice president of product development in the Mercury Marine division.
In premarket trading, Brunswick's shares were down 1% at $66.87. The stock had fallen 9% through Friday's close.
